IF_SENSITIVE_STORY: Ngacakutila ilyashi lyenu lyankama kabiyeni pa https:app.talktoloop.org/provide-feedback
TALK_TO_LOOP: Nangu cibe ifyo, nomba kuti mwatwebako ilyashi lyenu.
PERSONAL_DETAILS: Cawama, muli namupepei nokupwa. Kuti twafwaya ukwipushako amepusho yane pali imwe. Ici cilatwafwa ukutwala ilyashi lyenu kubantu abalingile.
DONT_REUSE_DETAILS: Cisuma, bushe mulefwaya ukwasuka aya amasuko nakabili?
USER_DISABILITY: (4/4) Mukulekelesha, bushe mwalilemanako munshila iili yonse?
GREETINGS: 👋 Mwapoleni! Uku kutangata kwabelako ukucitwa apopenefye pakulandapo ifyo muletontonkanya pakabungwe akalemboma muncende.
PROMOTE_DESCRIPTION: Cisuma. TalkToLoop.org e platform yenu iyo mwingabomfya ukulandilapo ifyo muletontonkanya nelyashi mukwete ilikankalala kuli imwe. Kuti mwaishibilapo ifingi pali Loop ngamwamona pali website yesu www.talktoloop.org
END_OF_SERVICE: Apapene epapelela ukutangata  kwa automatic. Kuti mwatutumina ilyashi nalimbi panshita iili yonse kutininkafye pakali batani kali pesamba.
THANKS:
Twamutotela pakubomfya TalkToLoop.org pakusosa ifyo mulekabila nokwalula ifintu mukuwamina bonse. Nomba twalapituluka nokusabankanya ilyashi lyenu munsa 24 ukufika ku 48, nangu limbi tekuti tufikenako twalayangufyanya. Twalamitumina amasuko ngatwayapokelela.

Shalenipo.

Pakutampa nakabili Lembeni 'Loop' nangu tinikeni ibatani pesamba inshita iili yonse 😃.
ADDITIONAL_INFO:
Bushe kuliko nafimbi ifyo mwingafwaya ukutweba mukulundapo pakutwafwa ukutwala ilyashi lyenikubantu abalingile? 
Kulifye, asukenifye kuli ili ilyashi 🏛️ nefilekabilwa pakabungwe kwati ishina lyakabungwe 🌏️ oshina elyo nakuntu basangwa nangu fimbi ifili fyonse ifyo  mwingatemwa ukulundako.
Ngacakutila mwapwisha tinikenifye pebatani ilili pesamba.
INVALID_OPTION: Munjeleko, nshikwetepo ubwishibililo. Mukwai salenipo pafibikilwe ukusalapo mukwangufyanyapesamba.

🏛️  ishina lyakabungwe
🌏️  icalo elyo nencende ukulefuma ilyashi
